study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Loreto et al., Alzheimer's & Dementia: Diagnosis, Assessment & Disease Monitoring, 2024
study_identification_part.si4_title: Alzheimer's disease heterogeneity revealed by neuroanatomical normative modeling

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Apply neuroanatomical normative modeling to a real-world clinical cohort with biomarker-confirmed Alzheimer's disease to map individual-level cortical thickness deviations, quantify total outlier count, and examine associations with phenotype, disease stage, depressive symptoms, and amyloid burden.

rci1_dataset_name.answer: Multi-site aggregated dataset (ABCD; Cam-CAN; CNP; FCON-1000; HCP; OASIS-3; PNC; TOP; UK Biobank). Site-matched adaptation dataset (n=20) from ICHT.
rci1_dataset_name.reason: Kia 2022 のモデルを使っている。
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: The reference cohort consisted of a group of 33,072 cognitively normal adults pooled from publicly available neuroimaging datasets under a previous study... The adaptation dataset consisted of a group of 20 cognitively normal (CN) older adults who had an MRI scan at ICHT for research purposes. (L99-103). Supplementary Table 1 lists: ABCD, Cam-CAN, CNP, FCON, HCP, OASIS3, PNC, TOP, UKBB.

rci9_site_effect_handling.detail: Hierarchical Bayesian regression with partial pooling; site/batch-specific parameters drawn from shared priors; adaptation with site-matched controls to recalibrate parameters; avoids separate harmonization (e.g., ComBat).
rci9_site_effect_handling.supporting_text: HBR... incorporates structural dependencies among model parameters by sharing a common prior... calculates z-statistics to account for both additive and multiplicative batch effects, obviating the need for data harmonization.

nm1_model_origin.detail: Reference normative model trained on 33,072 healthy participants across multiple public datasets; adapted using 20 site-matched CN controls at ICHT before generating z-scores for the clinical cohort.
nm1_model_origin.supporting_text: The reference cohort consisted of... 33,072... This model was then optimized using cortical thickness data from controls scanned at the same acquisition site (n = 20).

caa2_diseases_studied.reason: The study focuses on AD with staging including MCI and dementia.
caa2_diseases_studied.supporting_text: patients who were non-amnestic, at more advanced disease stages... MCI vs dementia; Alzheimer's disease stage (dementia/MCI)

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Cortical atrophy patterns in biomarker-confirmed AD are highly heterogeneous with the superior temporal sulcus most frequently outlying; higher total outlier counts occur in non-amnestic and more advanced cases and are negatively associated with amyloid burden.
